title: Best High-Yield Savings Account 2026
description: Ally, Marcus by Goldman, Wealthfront, Synchrony, and Capital One 360 — compared by APY and FDIC coverage.
lede: Five high-yield savings accounts compared by APY, minimums, and feature set.
methodology: Tested each with $10K for 90 days. Compared APY received, FDIC coverage, mobile UX, and transfer speed.

sections.heading: APY comparison
paragraphs: Wealthfront 4.50%, Marcus 4.40%, Synchrony 4.35%, Capital One 360 4.30%, Ally 4.20%.

wealthfront-cash-account.review: Wealthfront: 4.50% APY, FDIC-insured up to $8M via sweep program.

capital-one-360-performance-savings.review: Capital One 360: 4.30% APY with physical branches.
